intent_record.intent_summary: Refactors af_alg_count_tsgl by removing the unused offset parameter to simplify the interface.
intent_record.what: Removed the 'offset' parameter from the af_alg_count_tsgl function signature and deleted associated documentation comments.
intent_record.how: Changes the function API to always count SG entries from the beginning of the list, eliminating support for offset-based counting.

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplified scatterlist byte counting by removing incorrect offset tracking logic that was causing improper iteration behavior.
intent_record.what: Removed offset tracking logic including bytes_count variable, offset adjustment calculations, and conditional offset-skipping block. Replaced with simplified direct comparison using sg[i].length >= bytes and direct bytes subtraction.
intent_record.how: Eliminates complex offset handling that tracked position within scatterlist entries. Now directly compares each scatterlist entry length against remaining bytes needed, returning early when sufficient bytes are found. Simplifies the byte-counting loop by removing stateful offset management.

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplified the af_alg_pull_tsgl API by removing the dst_offset parameter and its associated documentation.
intent_record.what: Removed the 'dst_offset' parameter from the function signature of af_alg_pull_tsgl and deleted the corresponding kernel documentation comments describing that parameter.
intent_record.how: The function no longer accepts an offset argument, forcing all page reassignments to begin at the start of the destination scatterlist, which simplifies the caller's responsibility regarding buffer sizing and positioning.

intent_record.intent_summary: Removes unused local variables i, tsgl, and tmp from _aead_recvmsg to clean up dead code.
intent_record.what: Removed the declaration of unsigned int i and struct af_alg_tsgl pointers tsgl and tmp from the function scope.
intent_record.how: Eliminates dead code and prevents compiler warnings regarding unused variables without affecting runtime behavior.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactored TSGL management to allocate per-request scatterlist tables instead of searching a shared global list, improving isolation and adding proper memory error handling
intent_record.what: Replaced iteration through ctx->tsgl_list to find tsgl_src with creation of per-request TSGL: added af_alg_count_tsgl() call, sock_kmalloc() allocation for areq->tsgl, sg_init_table(), and af_alg_pull_tsgl() to populate the new scatterlist
intent_record.how: Changes TSGL handling from searching a shared global TX SGL list to allocating dedicated per-request scatterlist entries, adds proper memory allocation error handling (-ENOMEM), and ensures each request has its own tracked SG entries

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplified AEAD receive message handling by removing unnecessary in-place cipher operation complexity and unifying encryption/decryption code paths
intent_record.what: Removed ~60 lines of conditional encryption/decryption logic for in-place cipher operations and replaced with simplified memcpy_sglist call; changed aead_request_set_crypt source parameter from rsgl_src to tsgl_src
intent_record.how: Eliminates complex memory management for in-place crypto operations by using TX SGL directly as source instead of copying to RX SGL first; unifies encryption and decryption code paths into single implementation

intent_record.intent_summary: Clean up AF_ALG scatter-gather helper function signatures by removing redundant offset parameters.
intent_record.what: Removed the 'offset' parameter from af_alg_count_tsgl and 'dst_offset' parameter from af_alg_pull_tsgl function declarations.
intent_record.how: Simplifies the function interfaces by eliminating redundant offset arguments, allowing the scatterlist structure to manage data positioning internally.
